mapper.sql: vr.id, vr.match_pair_id AS matchPairId, vr.teacher_id AS teacherId, vr.student_id AS studentId, vr.meeting_id AS meetingId, vr.duration, vr.meeting_date AS meetingDate, vr.service_desc AS serviceDesc, vr.evidence_images AS evidenceImages, vr.ai_summary AS aiSummary, vr.status, vr.reject_reason AS rejectReason, vr.student_confirm_time AS studentConfirmTime, vr.admin_audit_time AS adminAuditTime, vr.auditor_id AS auditorId, vr.create_time AS createTime, vr.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT , t.real_name AS teacherName, s.real_name AS studentName FROM volunteer_record vr LEFT JOIN teacher_profile t ON vr.teacher_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN student_profile s ON vr.student_id = s.user_id WHERE s.school_id = #{schoolId} AND vr.status = 1 ORDER BY vr.create_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration), 0) FROM volunteer_record WHERE status = 2
